# Docs

- [Jackie-OS](/docs): A second brain and an always-on AI COO, sharing one memory.

- **What is this system?**
- [Jackie OS: for friends](/docs/what-it-does): A second brain and an always-on AI COO, sharing one memory.
- [The system map](/docs/system-map): How Jackie-OS remembers, acts, delegates, and reports back.
- [Concepts](/docs/concepts): Shared domain vocabulary — entities, named processes, and status concepts.
- [Ecosystem Architecture](/docs/architecture): The current Jackie-OS layers, work flow, and product boundaries.

- **What do I do?**
- [Jackie OS — operator cheat sheet](/docs/cheat-sheet): One page reference for everything else the system does automatically.
- [wrap-up](/docs/wrap-up): End-of-session handoff — roadmap reconcile, project-sync, ops-board kanban, vault Status, brief log, hot.md, commit + push.
- [hermes-ops](/docs/hermes-runbook)
- [new-project](/docs/add-a-project): One-shot onboarding for a new project — code repo or non-code — into Jackie OS.

- **What runs by itself?**
- [The day, hour by hour](/docs/schedule): Weekday timeline and scheduler layers for all Jackie-OS jobs.
- [Current flow](/docs/workers): How bb, Hermes, temporary workers, and Linear fit together.
- [Vault rhythm](/docs/vault-rhythm): Hub for Jackie-OS vault automation — morning stack, brief pipeline, vault indexes, sync, and parity between Mac skills and VPS scripts.
- [Project registry](/docs/project-registry): Single source of truth for project-sync, morning-brief, and wrap-up.

- **What's the plan?**
- [Roadmap — Active Plans](/docs/roadmap): Current forward work, shipped ledger, and tracking status.
- [Ideas Backlog](/docs/ideas-backlog): Speculative features, improvements, and future work.
- [Decisions Log](/docs/decisions): Shipped plans, architectural decisions, and lasting outcomes.

- **Look it up**
- [Jackie-OS Documentation Hub](/docs/master-index): Master index of every documentation surface — start here before building anything new.
- [System Catalog](/docs/catalog): Every skill and script in Jackie-OS — the map to navigate the system.
- [Skills Registry](/docs/skills-registry): Complete inventory of all skills — triggers, install paths, and naming convention.
- [Install & Setup](/docs/install): How to set up Jackie-OS from scratch.
